nom: PEACH & LILY MiniProtein Exosome Bioactive Ampoule

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin generally report the serum is light, non-greasy and absorbs well, with most saying it does not cause breakouts, though one reports it broke her out.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, psoriatic or autoimmune-related dry skin describe it as a game changer for hydration, softness and glow, with one noting she still layers a moisturizer and HA serum on top for extra needs.
segments.combination: The one reviewer identifying as severely combination and acne-prone found the texture uniquely absorbing and plumping without causing breakouts or makeup creasing.
segments.sensitive: Most self-described sensitive, reactive, dermatitis or eczema-prone reviewers report no irritation, rash or burning, though one sensitive-oily-acne-prone reviewer and one perimenopausal reviewer report breakouts or worsened cystic acne.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s-60s consistently describe firmer, plumper, more youthful-looking skin and reduced fine lines, often becoming a core routine staple.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report reduced fine lines, improved firmness, plumpness and a more youthful look, often within weeks; a few say it's too early to judge or see no change in lines yet.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe significant, often fast-acting hydration and plumping, including for chronic dryness from menopause, psoriasis or autoimmune conditions.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with broken capillaries reports a significant visible reduction after just a few uses, though she also notes irritation appeared after her third use in a row.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer used it specifically on weak, dry barrier areas and felt it helped keep skin moisturized, while another credits it with helping her skin tolerate tretinoin better.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report faded acne scarring, dark spots and hyperpigmentation with continued use, though results are described as gradual.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including acne-prone ones, report no new breakouts; however one reviewer says it worsened hormonal cystic acne significantly and another reports it broke her out despite liking the texture.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin describe the formula as light, non-greasy and fast-absorbing rather than heavy or pore-clogging.

extraits.titre: I wish I could use this, but I can't
extraits.texte: I'm sure this is lovely for some people. It has a great texture, no offensive scent and made my skin really hydrated and glowy. But my skin is currenly going through the horrors of perimenopause and it made my hormonal cystic acne 10x worse. I stopped using it 3 weeks ago and I'm still nursing some really bad scars and pimples that remain slighly raised after all that time. If you are prone to hormonal acne, I would think twice before trying this.

it's breaking me out. I'm definitely sad bc its a beautiful product. makes the skin look hydrated . not greasy at all. I am sensitive oily acne prone for ref. I say give it a go and hopefully you tolerate it! by the reviews, it seems generally well tolerated

Age 58, had dry skin even before it became "mature." Psoriatic skin must absorb products differently. Hard to find hydrators and moisturizers that don't just sit on top. Huge fan of Glass Skin Serum so I keep trying other P&L products. Many cause spots for me when layered, but this one is a keeper. First morn woke with with super soft skin. Only day 2 but been seeking extra night moisture that won't cause spots for ages so quite happy. Still deciding whether it needs a basic HA serum underneath. I do layer moisturizer on top.

extraits.titre: Broken capillary girlies…pull up a chair
extraits.texte: I tried this product in hopes of the plumping and firming benefits related to collagen loss and fine lines. After using this 3 times, I noticed a significant reduction in the visibility of the broken capillaries on my cheeks; this is the only product I've added into my routine. Broken capillaries are a huge pain point for me as no foundation or concealer completely covers them and I've tried laser 3x with no improvement. I was SHOCKED when I looked in the mirror this morning & hardly noticed my broken capillaries at all. I have extremely sensitive/reactive skin and I didn't notice any issues after using this serum twice. I did, however, experience some irritation after the 3rd use, so it seems like using 2x/week is my sweet spot. If you are also sensitive/reactive, I wouldn't be completely warded off by the reviews. The benefits of this product are compounding, so you should still see results even if you need to use it less than someone whose skin can tolerate using it 3+ days a week.

I have severely combination, acne prone skin. I do not use moisturizers at all, I actually prefer to layer toners, essences, serums, then lock it all in with SPF. I love P&L, so I was super excited to see them launch such an inventive new skincare product - I HAD to get 2 bottles during this recent BF/CM 40% off sale. Nevertheless, winter is here, my skin is extra dry, and I figuded a rich "ampoule" would do me good. Well yall.. I'm here to report back that it is GOOD! The texture is really unique. I wouldnt call this a lotion, an emulsion, or a serum. Its thick without being heavy and sitting on top of your skin. Really, it is heavenly - it actually ABSORBS and plumps up your skin so nicely. One issue I always had with super greasy "hydrating" skincare in the past is how they would cause my foundation to crease. This product does not do that! If I use this as my last step before SPF + IT CC matte foundation, my makeup is flawless and hydrated, sets by itself with no creasing. My advice is that this product functions best on top of an essence and a serum - using it alone would cause you to use up the entire bottle quickly, which is historically a reoccuring theme of P&L products, they are very "product hungry". For example, if you were to use this product on a dry face before a moisturizer and/or SPF, you would have to use 6+ pumps to cover your entire face and neck. Whereas, after prepping skin with my essences and light serums, I only have to use 3 pumps. I have the same is

I was worried to try this - it seemed like something that low key might not do anything for my skin. But I've been using it on areas where my skin barrier is weak and dry. It is helping keep my skin moisturized on a daily basis. Not sure if its a long term fix or more of a temporary delivery of moisture but I can feel and see a difference using it

extraits.texte: I have very dry skin, and this has been a game changer. It adds some extra hydration to my routine and definitely gives me a glow. I look better rested and my skin feels more firm - especially my cheeks. I've been using this for about 6 weeks and feel like I look 5 years younger just from the radiance this adds to my skin.
